name: Patrick SFB
description: Patrick SFB supports Eastern Range space launch operations and hosts Space Launch Delta 45. It is the primary launch support base for Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: South Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate. Visitor Control Center at South Gate.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1500; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required.

resources.name: Riverside Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting space launch operations with full meal service and grab-and-go options.
resources.hours: Daily: Bfast 0630-0900 (weekends 0630-0830), Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1900 (weekends 1630-1830); Grab & Go between meals

resources.name: Patrick Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Patrick SFB Main Exchange with food court, barber, beauty shop, optical, GNC, and retail services.

resources.name: Space Coast Credit Union

resources.name: Patrick Fitness & Sports Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports amenities. Pool closed for maintenance.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0500-2000; Sat-Sun 0700-1600; 24/7 registered CAC access outside staffed hours

resources.name: Cape Canaveral Fitness & Sports Center
resources.description: Secondary fitness facility supporting Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments supporting space launch personnel.

resources.name: Space Coast Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals. Guest business center available.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.

resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs supporting space launch operations.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.description: Equipment rental (boats, lawn equipment), family campground, RV storage, and recreational programs. 24-hour lawn equipment for AD/Reserve residents.

resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services supporting space launch operations.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Space Coast Inn (321-494-6590) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (321-494-3647) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 45 FSS, M&FRC, and official Patrick sites for in-processing and space launch support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
